initialize_InProcessCommunicator: initialize an InProcessCommunicator with a given rank and world size for in-process distributed communication
send_recv_tensors: send a tensor to a destination rank and receive a tensor from a source rank using the mailbox
all_reduce_tensor: reduce a tensor across all ranks using a reduce operation like SUM and return the result to all
all_gather_tensors: gather tensors from all ranks into a sorted list on each rank using the in-process mailbox
broadcast_tensor: broadcast a tensor from a source rank to all other ranks in the in-process communicator
